SELECT pi.delivery_type AS deliveryType, pi.school_id AS schoolId, pi.school_name_snapshot AS schoolNameSnapshot, pi.station_id AS stationId, pi.station_name_snapshot AS stationNameSnapshot, pi.window_id AS windowId, pi.window_name_snapshot AS windowNameSnapshot, pi.offer_id AS offerId, pi.offer_sku_id AS offerSkuId, pi.sku_id AS skuId, pi.product_name_snapshot AS productNameSnapshot, pi.issue_id AS issueId, pi.issue_no AS issueNo, pi.issue_name AS issueName, pi.planned_delivery_date AS plannedDeliveryDate, COALESCE(SUM(pi.count), 0) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.order_id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.student_id) AS studentCount
GROUP BY pi.delivery_type, pi.school_id, pi.school_name_snapshot, pi.station_id, pi.station_name_snapshot, pi.window_id, pi.window_name_snapshot, pi.offer_id, pi.offer_sku_id, pi.sku_id, pi.product_name_snapshot, pi.issue_id, pi.issue_no, pi.issue_name, pi.planned_delivery_date ORDER BY pi.delivery_type ASC, pi.issue_no ASC, pi.station_id ASC, pi.offer_sku_id ASC, pi.sku_id ASC
